added.description:

A career at Flex offers the opportunity to make a difference and invest in your growth in a respectful, inclusive, and collaborative environment. If you are excited about a role but don't meet every bullet point, we encourage you to apply and join us to create the extraordinary.

Job Summary

The Director, Operations Engineering
serves as the site's senior engineering leader, reporting to the General Manager
, responsible for defining and executing the engineering strategy that supports business growth, operational excellence, new product introduction (NPI), and manufacturing performance. This role leads Process, Manufacturing, Test, Mechanical Design, Automation, and NPI Engineering functions across complex Automotive, Cloud, Industrial, and advanced manufacturing operations.

As a key member of the Site Leadership Team, the Director, Operations Engineering
partners with Operations, Quality, Supply Chain, Program Management, and Global Engineering teams to drive manufacturing innovation, optimize operational performance, and deliver scalable, high-quality production solutions. This leader will balance strategic business objectives, technical engineering expertise, customer engagement, and talent development to enable sustainable growth in a high-volume manufacturing environment.

What a typical day looks like:

Define and execute the site's Operations Engineering strategy, aligning manufacturing technology, process capability, automation, and engineering roadmaps with business objectives, customer requirements, and long-term growth plans.
Lead engineering support for complex Automotive, Cloud, Industrial, and electromechanical products, translating customer specifications into scalable manufacturing architectures that support qualification, ramp-up, and high-volume production.
Direct Process, Manufacturing, Mechanical Design, Test, Automation, and NPI Engineering teams, ensuring technical excellence across SMT, PCBA, backend manufacturing, system integration, rack assembly, box build, cleanroom operations, and automated production environments.
Drive factory performance through process design and optimization, manufacturing readiness assessments, capacity planning, line balancing, equipment selection, industrialization, yield improvement, defect reduction, and cost optimization initiatives.
Establish and govern robust NPI and product industrialization processes, utilizing DFM, DFA, DFT, and Design for Automation methodologies to ensure manufacturability, quality, reliability, and successful product launches.
Own site-wide process and product qualification activities, including equipment qualification, process validation, first article inspections, production validation builds, reliability testing, and manufacturing readiness reviews, while ensuring compliance with APQP, PPAP, FMEA, SPC, MSA, and customer-specific quality requirements.
Champion advanced manufacturing and Industry 4.0 initiatives through the deployment of robotics, vision systems, smart factory technologies, real-time analytics, and data-driven process controls to improve productivity, quality, and operational scalability.
Lead engineering risk management and quality governance by driving PFMEA, DFMEA, failure analysis, root cause investigations, corrective actions, process controls, and audit readiness to enhance product reliability and manufacturing robustness.
Ensure comprehensive ownership of manufacturing documentation, engineering change management, process specifications, SOPs, control plans, validation records, and knowledge management systems to support compliance, traceability, and standardized execution.
Serve as the executive technical leader for customers and site leadership, presenting engineering strategies, supporting technical reviews and audits, managing engineering investments and KPIs, and developing a high-performing engineering organization focused on innovation, safety, quality, and operational excellence.

The experience we’re looking to add to our team:

Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related technical discipline.
12+ years of progressive manufacturing engineering experience.
8+ years of engineering leadership experience managing multiple engineering disciplines.
Experience supporting Automotive manufacturing environments.
Experience leading engineering organizations supporting high-volume manufacturing operations.
Demonstrated success leading NPI and mass production environments.

Preferred Qualifications

Master's Degree in Engineering, Operations Management, or MBA.
Lean Six Sigma Black Belt Certification
ASQ Certified Manager of Quality/Organizational Excellence (CMQ/OE).
Project Management Professional (PMP).
Experience in highly regulated industries including Automotive, Cloud Infrastructure, Industrial, Medical, or Aerospace manufacturing environments.

added.title: Director, Autonomous Vehicles Platform
added.description:
Job Requisition ID

JR2002272

Job Category

Engineering

Time Type

Full time

The era of AI is here — and it's transforming how machines learn, reason, and interact with the world. Today, AI-powered autonomous vehicles can navigate rural roads at night, understand dynamic environments, and make real-time driving decisions.

In this role, you will work closely with key OEM partners to lead end-to-end platform integration and adapt our technology to OEM solutions.

You will also lead the architecture and development of vehicle and sensor abstraction layers that bridge our autonomous driving software with the physical world — from low-level sensor inputs and actuator commands to scalable integration with real-world hardware.

As a key contributor to enabling real-time autonomy at scale, you will help shape the future of robotics and self-driving technology.

What You Will Be Doing

Collaborate with key OEM partners to lead full platform integration and adapt our technology to OEM solutions.
Lead the Vehicle Adaptation Layer (VAL) and Sensor Adaptation Layer (SAL) teams, designing and developing software abstractions and plug-in frameworks that interface with vehicle and sensor systems while delivering exceptional customer outcomes.
Build efficient, user-friendly mechanisms to improve software integration across a wide range of vehicles and sensor configurations.
Enhance existing frameworks and software components, validating improvements through extensive real-world and synthetic testing to enhance computational performance and system utilization.
Conduct in-vehicle tests, collect and analyze sensor and vehicle data, and support the completion of autonomous drive missions.
Develop unit tests and documentation for key features, evaluate software quality, and propose corrective actions in alignment with industry best practices.
Write highly efficient, production-quality C++ code, demonstrating parallel computing capabilities through GPGPU (CUDA) to accelerate processing workloads.
Follow industry safety and quality standards, including MISRA and other automotive-grade software development practices.

What We Need To See

MS or PhD in Computer Engineering, Computer Science or related Engineering fields (or equivalent experience).
15+ overall years of relevant industry experience and 8+ years of managing a team.
Excellent C and C++ programming skills.
Experience developing and debugging multithreaded/distributed applications like multimedia systems, game engines, etc.
Strong knowledge of programming and debugging techniques, especially for parallel and distributed architectures.
Strong knowledge on Linux, Android, and/or other real-time operating systems.
Experience with frameworks for robotics such as ROS and/or for multimedia such as GStreamer.
Passion for writing low-latency, high-performance software.
Excellent communication and analytical skills.
Self-motivated and a strong team-oriented mindset

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

Understanding of embedded and heterogeneous architectures, including GPUs.
Knowledge of automotive systems, including ADAS applications, AUTOSAR and drive-by-wire systems.
Be hands-on and work well within a team of algorithm, software and hardware engineers, with a significant level of detail orientation and a penchant for data organization and presentation
Experience developing software using modern OpenGL (Core Profile) on Linux.
Experience with version control systems GIT and build system like CMake/Bazel.

NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers with some of the most forward-thinking and dedicated people in the world working here. If you want to help make autonomous vehicles and robotics progress in challenging contexts, we want to hear from you!

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 320,000 USD - 488,750 USD.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

Applications for this job will be accepted at least until September 5, 2026.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

updated.title: Director of Piston Pin Engineering
updated.description:
About The Role

Amsted Automotive Group, Piston Pin Business Unit,
is looking for a Director of Engineering to provide hands-on leadership driving manufacturing process design, standardization, and continuous improvement. Owns product application engineering, program management, and APQP execution while developing talent, building high-performing teams, and delivering measurable gains in quality and efficiency. Shapes engineering strategy and fosters accountability and operational excellence.

What You'll Do

Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing engineering team; drive accountability and continuous technical excellence.
Standardize manufacturing processes across all piston pin facilities to eliminate defects and maximize efficiency.
Foster a culture of data-driven problem solving and continuous improvement.
Ensure full compliance with internal standards and external requirements (IATF 16949, ISO 9001).
Partner with Quality to resolve process nonconformances and implement robust corrective/preventive actions.
Own business unit APQP, PPAP, and FMEA processes to ensure product and manufacturing process integrity.
Drive process optimization initiatives to improve efficiency, global capacity, reduce cost, and eliminate waste.
Champion Lean, Six Sigma, and other CI methodologies to increase throughput and reduce variation.
Leverage key operating metrics to identify trends, diagnose issues, and drive performance.
Evaluate emerging technologies and assess applicability to future operations.
Communicate clearly with senior leadership on progress, risks, and strategic opportunities.

What You'll Need To Succeed

Leadership and team development: Demonstrated ability to build, lead, mentor, and reorganize teams to improve performance
Education: Bachelor of Science degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial Engineering, or a related field required; advanced engineering degree and/or MBA preferred.
Automotive engineering experience: 10–15 years of automotive engineering management experience, preferably in cold forming, heat treating, CNC machining, centerless grinding, metals forming, machining, fabrication, or related manufacturing processes.
Quality systems and core tools: Experience with AIAG and IATF tools, including implementation in an automotive manufacturing environment.
Problem solving and analytics: Strong disciplined critical-thinking skills with an analytical DMAIC approach; experience using statistical process capability methods and tools such as Minitab or other SPC analysis programs.
Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively across all levels of the organization.
Results orientation: Proven history of driving continuous improvement and financial improvement projects that deliver measurable business impact
Leadership and integrity: Highest ethical standards, with strong communication skills and the ability to motivate, lead, and develop individuals to perform at their best.
Engineering career progression: Demonstrated career growth in engineering, including experience in manufacturing operations, manufacturing or product design engineering, and/or quality engineering.
Continuous improvement and business impact: Proven history of executing continuous improvement projects related to manufacturing cost control, cost of quality, and product/process standardization, with clear ownership of projects that delivered measurable fiscal impact.
Team building and performance: Demonstrated ability to build teams that achieve stretch results.
Manufacturing process expertise: Familiarity with high-precision metal manufacturing processes such as cold forming, heat treating, CNC machining, centerless grinding, metals forming, machining, or fabrication in a manufacturing environment, not assembly-only operations.
Automotive quality systems: Thorough understanding of the automotive business environment and related quality systems, including ISO/TS standards, APQP, DFMEA, PFMEA, and formal corrective action processes.
Customer and technical communication: Strong customer communication skills, including the ability to deliver technical presentations in support of process execution and business development.
Leadership and travel: Experience managing in a multi-plant business environment and leading teams where English is not the primary language; willingness and ability to travel to all business unit locations, with expected travel of approximately 50% in the first year and 30% in following years.
Language capability: Multilingual fluency preferred, specifically Spanish or Italian.

What Else You'll Need To Know

This role will require periods of international travel
Candidates must be comfortable getting dirty and working in loud environments

We create a supportive environment where employees thrive! With a range of benefits designed to enhance your health, well-being, and financial security, we’re here to support you every step of the way. Join us and experience the exceptional perks that make Amsted Automotive a great place to work!
